custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১) It is certain that she will prevail. (Make it simple)
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: She will be prevailful is certain.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
Complex: It is certain that she will prevail.
Simple: Certainly she will prevail.

• Complex sentence এ it is certain, it is surely, it is sudden থাকলে Simple sentence এ -
- It is certain এর পরিবর্তে certainly হবে + এর পরের relative pronoun টি বাদ যাবে + বাকি sentence টি বসবে।
• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, সঠিক উত্তর - Certainly, she will prevail.

• অন্য দিকে, 
- it is sure এর পরিবর্তে surely হবে
- it is sudden এর পরিবর্তে suddenly হবে.

যেমন:
Complex: It is certain that he will come here.
Simple: Certainly, he will come here.

Complex: It was sudden that he lost his mobile.
Simple: Suddenly, he lost his mobile.

Complex: It is sure that he has done it.
Simple: Surely, he has done it.

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar and Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ২) What does the word "Sinister" mean?
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Bright and cheerful
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The word "sinister" primarily refers to - Evil or harmful.

• Sinister (adjective)
English Meaning: Something that is threatening, evil, or harmful, often suggesting that something bad or dangerous is likely to happen.
Bangla Meaning: অশুভ; ক্ষতিকর; বিপদজনক।

Example Sentence:
- There was a sinister silence in the room before the storm hit.
- His sinister smile made everyone feel uneasy.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ৩) Azad is the best player in the team. (Make it Comparative)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: Azad is better than most other players in the team.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Azad is better than any other players in the team.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: Azad is the better player in the team.
Daily-Quiz:140.option4: Azad is better than all other players in the team.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• One of the ছাড়া শুধু the + Superlative Degree থাকলে – comparative degree করতে হলে,
- comparative degree + (than any other + singular noun) / (than all other + plural noun) বসে।
• Subject + verb + Superlative এর comparative form + than any other + প্রদত্ত sentence বাকী অংশ।

Example:
Superlative: Azad is the best player in the team.
Comparative:
- Azad is better than any other player in the team.
- Azad is better than all other players in the team.

• অন্যদিকে,
• One of the থাকলে Comparative করার সময়
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর object হবে subject + verb + positive degree এর comparative form + One of the এর পরিবর্তে than many other + Plural Noun অথবা than most other + Plural Noun + বাকি অংশ বসে।

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ৪) Which of the following is closest in meaning to "Vacillate"?
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Determine
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The closest in meaning to 'Vacillate' is - Sway.

• Vacillate (verb)
English Meaning: To waver between different opinions or actions; to be indecisive.
Bangla Meaning: দ্বিধাগ্রস্ত হওয়া; একমত না হওয়া; মনের মধ্যে দ্বন্দ্ব থাকা।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Sway - দুলানো; সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে অস্থির হওয়া।

- Conclude - সিদ্ধান্তে পৌঁছানো; চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া।

- Determine - সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া; স্পষ্টভাবে সিদ্ধান্ত করা।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ৫) Choose the correct spelling.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Retrrorflection
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The correct spelling is - Retroreflection. (অপশন 'ঘ')

• Retroreflection (noun)
English Meaning: The reflection of light or other radiation back to its source with minimal scattering.
Bangla Meaning: আলো বা বিকিরণকে উৎসের দিকে প্রায় অপরিবর্তিতভাবে প্রতিফলনের প্রক্রিয়া।

Example Sentence:
- Road signs use retroreflection to remain visible at night.
- Retroreflection technology improves safety in low-light conditions.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ৬) Unless you study well, you will not succeed. (Make it Compound)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: You study well and will succeed.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Study well or you will not succeed.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: Study well anyhow you will not succeed.
Daily-Quiz:140.option4: Without studying well and you will not succeed.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
Complex Sentence: Unless you study well, you will not succeed.
Compound Sentence: Study well or you will not succeed.

• Unless (complex) ↔ or (compound)
- Unless you study well, you will not succeed. এটি একটি Complex Sentence.
- Complex sentence এর শুরুতে "Unless” ও এর পরে second person (you) থাকলে, Compound sentence- এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- Unless ও you উঠে যাবে + দুই clause এর মাঝে "or" বসে।

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ৭) People always admire great visionaries. (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: Great visionaries will always be admired by people.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Great visionaries are always admired by the people.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: Great visionaries are always being admired.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
Active: People always admire great visionaries.
Passive: Great visionaries are always admired.

• Active voice কে Passive Voice- এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active Voice এর object টি Passive Voice এর Subject হয়।
- Active Voice এর মূল Verb এর form অনুযায়ী অতিরিক্ত ‘be’ Verb বসে।
- মূল verb এর Past Participle form বসে।
- Active Voice এর subject টি Passive Voice এর Object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• তবে,  Active Voice এর Subject People হলে, তা Passive Voice এর Object হিসেবে না লিখলেও চলে।

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ৮) What is the antonym of "Wheedle"?
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Compliment
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The antonym of "Wheedle" is "Repel."

• Wheedle (verb)
English Meaning: To persuade or influence someone to do something by using flattery, charm, or deceptive words.
Bangla Meaning: মিষ্টি কথায় কাউকে রাজি করানো; চাটুকারিতা করা।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Repel - বিরক্ত করা; দূরে ঠেকানো।

- Charm - আকর্ষণ করা; মুগ্ধ করা।

- Compliment - প্রশংসা করা।

- Coax - নম্রভাবে রাজি করানো।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ৯) What does the word "Tentative" mean?
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Slow and careful
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The word "Tentative" primarily refers to - Uncertain and provisional.

• Tentative (adjective)
English Meaning: Something that is uncertain, temporary, or not yet finalized. It is used when something is done without full confidence or commitment, often due to a lack of complete information or certainty.
Bangla Meaning: অনিশ্চিত; প্রাথমিক; অস্থায়ী।

Example Sentences:
- He made a tentative decision to move abroad, but he wasn’t sure yet.
- The tentative plan was subject to change after further discussions.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১০) He studied hard in order to pass the exam. (Make it complex)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: He studied hard so and he passed the exam.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: He studies hard so that he pass the exam.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: Though he studied hard, he pass the exam.
Daily-Quiz:140.option4: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• Simple Sentence: He studied hard in order to pass the exam. 
• Complex Sentence: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.

• Simple Sentence এ 'in order to' থাকলে Complex Sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: 
- In order to এর স্থলে In order that অথবা So that বসবে। 
- এরপর noun phrase + can/could বসবে। 
- Present tense এর ক্ষেত্রে may এবং Past tense এর ক্ষেত্রে might বসে। 

Simple: We earn money in order to live a happy life. 
Complex: We earn money so that we may live a happy life. 

Simple: He studied hard in order to pass the exam. 
Complex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam. 

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hussain.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১১) Identify the correct spelling.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Subterranean
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The correct spelling is – Subterranean. (অপশন 'খ')

• Subterranean (adjective)
English Meaning: existing, occurring, or done under the earth’s surface.
Bangla Meaning: ভূগর্ভস্থ; মাটির নিচে অবস্থিত বা সংঘটিত।

Example Sentences:
- The explorers discovered a vast subterranean cave system beneath the mountains.
- Many animals live in subterranean burrows to protect themselves from predators and harsh weather.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১২) Though he is allergic to gluten, he ate the dessert. (compound)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: He is allergic to gluten, and then ate the dessert.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: He is allergic to gluten, so ate the dessert.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: He is allergic to gluten, and ate the dessert.
Daily-Quiz:140.option4: He is allergic to gluten, but ate the dessert.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• Though/although যুক্ত complex sentence কে compound sentence এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম:

• Though/although উঠে যায়,
- ১ম clause টি বসে,
- but বসে,
- ২য় clause বসে।

Complex: Though he tried to pray, he could not get rid of the curse.
Compound: He tried to pray but could not get rid of the curse.

Complex: Though he is allergic to gluten, he ate the dessert.
Compound: He is allergic to gluten, but ate the dessert.

Source: Advanced Learners by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১৩) Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Yield."
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Obey
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The opposite of 'Yield' is - Defy.

Yield (verb)
English Meaning: to give way to pressure or force, surrender, or submit to something.
Bangla Meaning: সমর্পণ করা; মাথা নত করা; বাধ্য হওয়া।

অপশন আলোচনা:
- Defy - বিরোধিতা করা; অস্বীকার করা; প্রতিরোধ করা।

- Obey - অধিকার মেনে চলা; শৃঙ্খলাবদ্ধ থাকা।

- Compromise - আপস করা; সমঝোতা করা।

- Release - মুক্তি দেওয়া; ছাড় দেওয়া।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১৪) Very few universities are as renowned as Harvard. (Make it superlative)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: Harvard is one of the most renowned than other university.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Harvard is the most renowned than most other universities.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: Harvard is one of the most renowned universities.
Daily-Quiz:140.option4: Harvard is the most renowned university.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• Positive: Very few universities are as renowned as Harvard.
• Superlative: Harvard is one of the most renowned universities.

• Positive to superlative: নিয়মানুযায়ী, 
- Positive degree তে very  থাকলে Superlative degree তে one of the + superlative হয়। 
- প্রথমে positive এর Object টি Superlative বাক্যের Subject এ পরিণত হয়।
- তারপর Indicator পরিবর্তন ঘটে, 'Very few' ও 'as-as' উঠে তার পরিবর্তে one of the বসে। 
- Positive degree এর superlative form বসে। 
- তারপর Subject টি Object হিসেবে শেষে বসে।

More Example:
Positive: Very few cars are as luxurious as Rolls-Royce.
Superlative: Rolls-Royce is one of the most luxurious cars.

• অন্যদিকে, 
• Positive degree তে no other থাকলে Superlative degree তে the + superlative হয়। 
Example: 
Positive: No other university is as prestigious as Harvard.
Superlative: Harvard is the most prestigious university.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১৫) Which of the following is the opposite of "Zealot"?
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Radical
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The opposite of 'Zealot' is – Pragmatist

• Zealot (noun)
English Meaning: A person who is fanatical and uncompromising in pursuit of their religious, political, or other ideals.
Bangla Meaning: উগ্র বা কট্টরপন্থী ব্যক্তি; কোনো বিশ্বাস বা মতাদর্শে অন্ধভাবে নিবেদিত ব্যক্তি।

অপশন আলোচনা:
ক) Pragmatist – বাস্তববাদী ব্যক্তি; যে ব্যক্তি তত্ত্বের চেয়ে বাস্তবতাকে গুরুত্ব দেয়।

খ) Radical – মৌলবাদী; প্রচলিত পদ্ধতির বিরোধী এবং মৌলিক পরিবর্তনের পক্ষপাতী।

গ) Extremist – উগ্রপন্থী; চরমপন্থা অবলম্বনকারী ব্যক্তি।

সঠিক উত্তর: ক) Pragmatist

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১৬) Run and die. (simple)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: If you do not run, you will die.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: If you run, you will die.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• Compound Sentence: Run and die. 
• Simple Sentence: By running, you will die.

- একটি simple sentence এ শুধু মাত্র একটি clause থাকে অর্থাৎ একটি subject and একটি finite verb থাকে।
- and যুক্ত compound sentence কে by/without + verb +ing এই নিয়মে simple sentence এ পরিণত করা যায়। 

- প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্য, Run and die দ্বারা মূলত নড়লেই মারা পরবে এমন টা বুঝানো হয়েছে।
- তাই সঠিক simple sentence হবে - By running, you will die.

- তবে, Without running you will die. এই বাক্যটি সঠিক হবেনা কারণ তখন বাক্যের মূল অর্থ পরিবর্তন হয়ে যায়।

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১৭) What does "Unequivocal" mean?
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Clear and unambiguous
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• The word "unequivocal" primarily refers to - Clear and unambiguous.

• Unequivocal (adjective)

English Meaning: Clear and having only one possible interpretation; not open to doubt or confusion.
Bangla Meaning: অস্বীকারযোগ্য; স্পষ্ট এবং একধরনের।

Example Sentence:
- His response was unequivocal; he did not support the proposal.
- The evidence presented in court was unequivocal, leaving no room for doubt.

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১৮) What does the word "Rampant" mean?
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Rare and endangered
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• Rampant (adjective)
English Meaning: Something that is widespread and uncontrolled, usually in a negative sense, such as a disease, problem, or growth.
Bangla Meaning: অতিরিক্ত বিস্তৃত এবং নিয়ন্ত্রণহীন।

Example Sentences:
- The rampant spread of the disease caused panic in the city.
- Corruption was rampant in the government, making it difficult for any reforms to succeed.

So, the correct answer to your question is:
ঘ) Widespread and uncontrolled

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ১৯) One should maintain the meal etiquette. (passive)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: The meal etiquette should be maintained.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: The meal etiquette should have to be maintained by one's.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: The meal etiquette should to be maintained.
Daily-Quiz:140.option4: The meal etiquette should have to be maintained by one.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
Active voice: One should maintain the meal etiquette.
Passive voice: The meal etiquette should be maintained.

• One + should যুক্ত Sentence কে passive করার নিয়ম:
1. প্রথমে object টি Subject রূপে বসে, অর্থাৎ, Active voice-এর object-কে passive voice-এর subject হিসেবে ব্যবহার করা হয়।
2. Active voice-এর "One" উঠিয়ে দেওয়া হয়।
3. should be + মূল Verb এর Past Participle বসে।

More Examples:
Active Voice: One should take care of one's health.
Passive Voice: Health should be taken care of.

Active: One should tell the truth.
Passive: Truth should be told.

Active voice: One should follow the traffic rules.
Passive voice: The traffic rules should be followed.

Daily-Quiz:140.question: ২০) Marzina is wiser than Nazma. (Make it positive)
Daily-Quiz:140.option1: Nazma is not less wise then Marzina.
Daily-Quiz:140.option2: Nazma is not wise than Marzina.
Daily-Quiz:140.option3: Nazma is not so wise as Marzina.
Daily-Quiz:140.option4: Nazma is not wise as Marzina.
Daily-Quiz:140.exp:
• Than যুক্ত comparative sentence কে positive করার নিয়ম: 

- প্রদত্ত sentence এর than এর পরের অংশ প্রথমে বসে। 
- verb বসে। 
- not বসে। (মূল sentence টি affirmative হলে কিন্তু মূল sentence টি negative হলে not উথে যায়।)
- so বসে। 
- comparative degree এর positive form বসে। 
- as বসে। 
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর প্রথম subject বসে। 

• Affirmative sentence - এর positive degree - তে ‘as...as’ এবং negative sentence - এ `so...as’ ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Comparative: Marzina is wiser than Nazma.
Positive: Nazma is not so wise as Marzina.
